nama_en: Seeking Refuge from the Whisperings of Satan
arti_id: Aku berlindung kepada Allah dari godaan syaitan yang terkutuk.
arti_en: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan, from his madness, his pride, and his whisperings.
src: HR. Abu Dawud 1/206, At-Tirmidzi, lihat Shahih At-Tirmidzi 1/77, dan lihat surah Al-Mukminun 98-99. - Sumber: Hisnul Muslim.
